outcome.Summary: Implemented cmd/report (package main): run() parses --by region|product (default region) and --top N (N≥1) flags, reads CSV with encoding/csv (arbitrary column order, extra columns tolerated), validates required columns (error names the missing column) and per-row qty/price (error includes 1-based line number, header = line 1), aggregates revenue in integer cents, prints groups sorted by revenue descending then name ascending with 2-decimal revenue, and a TOTAL line over all rows. Added 18 tests in cmd/report/main_test.go covering the example, grouping, ties, top limits, shuffled/extra columns, and all error cases. Verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./...` (exit 0) and by running the binary against the spec example, which produced the expected output.
